description: fwd_exllamav3 now requires caller inference mode for its in-place mask of inference-tensor logits.
trigger: Calling fwd_exllamav3 outside torch.inference_mode after Model.forward returns an inference tensor.
expected_behavior: The caller must enter inference mode before the adapter masks logits in place.
actual_behavior: Model.forward is decorated with inference_mode. Its returned inference tensor is modified in place by the new vocabulary mask; outside inference mode this is disallowed. compare_q.main now supplies the required context, and the only in-tree caller is test_ppl under main, so no broken in-tree path is established at this commit.

introductions.rationale: 162 adds both the in-place mask and the main inference-mode decorator that satisfies its requirement.

verification.description: Reviewer traced the Model.forward decorator, adapter in-place mask and test_ppl/main caller chain using the documented PyTorch inference-tensor mutation rule.
verification.limits: No PyTorch, model or GPU execution. This is a caller requirement already satisfied by main, not an observed in-tree failure.

affected_revisions.limits: Requirement introduced and satisfied on the in-tree main path at 162; no continuous range or runtime failure claimed.

cutoff_note: Post-hoc reviewer observation; administrative only, never teacher input.
